title: Detailed rainbow
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Clouds -->
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='78' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#dfefff'/>
    <ellipse cx='12' cy='75' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <ellipse cx='24' cy='74' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='80' rx='12' ry='6' fill='#c8e0ff'/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='78' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#dfefff'/>
    <ellipse cx='76' cy='75' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <ellipse cx='88' cy='74' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <ellipse cx='82' cy='80' rx='12' ry='6' fill='#c8e0ff'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Rainbow bands: outer to inner -->
  <!-- Red -->
  <path d='M10 76 A 40 40 0 0 1 90 76' fill='none' stroke='#ff3b3b' stroke-width='7' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Orange -->
  <path d='M16 76 A 34 34 0 0 1 84 76' fill='none' stroke='#ff9f1c' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Yellow -->
  <path d='M22 76 A 28 28 0 0 1 78 76' fill='none' stroke='#ffe74c' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Green -->
  <path d='M28 76 A 22 22 0 0 1 72 76' fill='none' stroke='#3ddc68' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Blue -->
  <path d='M34 76 A 16 16 0 0 1 66 76' fill='none' stroke='#3fa9ff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Indigo/Violet -->
  <path d='M39 76 A 11 11 0 0 1 61 76' fill='none' stroke='#a45dff' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Soft highlight on rainbow edges -->
  <path d='M10 76 A 40 40 0 0 1 90 76' fill='none' stroke='#ff8a8a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>
  <path d='M39 76 A 11 11 0 0 1 61 76' fill='none' stroke='#d4b0ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Rainbow sparkles / dots -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='36' r='2.2' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='37' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#ffe74c' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='42' r='1.6' fill='#ffe74c' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='51' r='1.4' fill='#3ddc68' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='51' r='1.4' fill='#3ddc68' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#a45dff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#a45dff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Inner sky glow -->
  <path d='M42 76 A 8 8 0 0 1 58 76' fill='none' stroke='#2a1a4a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
